app.title: Access and audit console
app.subtitle: Every sensitive action goes through a permission AND leaves a trail. This is where the two meet.
enforcement.offTitle: Audit mode: permissions do not block
enforcement.offBody: The enforcement flag is off. Everything is visible and everything can be attempted, and every attempt without a permission is recorded as "would have been blocked". It is a transition state to migrate without breaking anyone's work, not a destination.
common.reasonPlaceholder: Say why you are doing this. It goes into the audit log.
common.reasonRequired: A reason is required: at least {{min}} characters.
users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Who this console administers, and which roles each person reaches through their memberships.
users.confirmBody: {{username}} will be deactivated and their sessions revoked at the identity provider. They stop being able to sign in. This action CANNOT be undone from here and is recorded in the audit log with your name and your reason.
roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.subtitle: Columns are the catalog declared in code. Rows are this company's roles.
roles.readOnlyNotice: You can view the matrix but not change it.
roles.confirmGrantBody: Everyone who reaches the {{role}} role through their memberships will be able to {{permission}} from their next request. This is recorded in the audit log with your name and your reason.
roles.confirmRevokeBody: Everyone who reaches the {{role}} role stops being able to {{permission}} from their next request. This is recorded in the audit log with your name and your reason.
roles.noChange: No change: it was already like that.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: What was done, and what someone tried to do without being able to. Two different questions, two tables.
audit.onlyWouldBlock: Only what would have been blocked
audit.subject: On what
audit.pendingHint: Rows with a pending external effect are the ones left half-done with an external system. That is the main reason anyone opens this screen.
audit.readOnlyHint: Read only: the audit log is never edited or deleted, and the database enforces it with a trigger.
